rows.en: I made a little too much...
Ai: "Of course! Ai-chan's proud of these!"
Touya: "Then don't mind if I do... Munch, munch."
Touya: "Yeah. You don't look like you'd be any good at this..."
Back home, they even called me Patissier Ai-chan,
I don't make them often, so be sure to savor them!"
Touya: "If only I hadn't seen the disaster you left behind."
Ai: "Hey... A few sacrifices come with cooking!
If you're going to say that, give them back!"
Touya: "Oh, no you don't... Chomp, chomp, chomp, chomp!"
Ai: "Besides, judging people by their looks..."
Ai: "...You're not listening to a word I say..."
Ai: "Honestly, that's what happens when you rush... Here, tea."
Ai: "Honestly... You're just like a child."
Ai: "...These are the cookies I promised Alforina
we'd make. She said she'd never made anything like this,
so I was going to teach her..."
Ai: "We never got to do it.
But... I thought I should at least keep my side of the promise.
That's what I thought... My feelings..."
Do you think they reached her?"
Touya: "...Never mind that. Do you need something?"
I thought I'd get something to eat before we arrive.
I just confiscated some meat Derock had stashed away,
so I thought I'd roast it."
Unlike you, I've only got an ordinary person's stomach."
Fain: "I see, I see. Well, we train differently,
Fain: "If that's how it is, so be it.
I'll eat alone. Sorry to interrupt."
Ai: "To make cookies... together, next time...
She was... just an ordinary fourteen-year-old girl..."
That we'd make cookies together next time...
She was just an ordinary fourteen-year-old girl..."
Touya: "...You made them for her... For Queen Alforina,
didn't you? I can't accept something like that."
Ai: "No. You were thinking of Alforina too, Touya,
I'm the one who should apologize. See you."
